description: One vacancy or open call with its department, its domains, its attached files and the text of its notice. Answers for a closed offer too, and says that it is closed. When you present an offer, link to "url", its page on the site, and to "official_url", the official notice.

reference.description: The reference as the institution prints it, such as "MENA/COM/2026/1802", or the address of the page on this site (the field "url" of a list).

name: get_vacancy

official_pages_last_read.description: When the site last read the official pages, UTC.
